Comparison

Midjourney vs Ideogram

A side-by-side look at Midjourney and Ideogram, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose Midjourney when your priority is: artistic, stylised imagery where aesthetic quality matters more than precise control. Choose Ideogram when your priority is: any image that must contain readable, correctly spelled text.

Midjourney vs Ideogram at a glance

CriteriaMidjourneyIdeogram
CategoryAI Image GeneratorsAI Image Generators
Best forArtistic, stylised imagery where aesthetic quality matters more than precise control.Any image that must contain readable, correctly spelled text.
Pricing modelSubscriptionFreemium
Free planNoYes
Free trialNoNo
API availableNoYes
Platforms
  • Web app (midjourney.com), Discord bot
  • Web, iOS, Android
Key features
  • Text-to-image with distinctive aesthetic quality
  • image-to-image and style references (--sref)
  • character references (--cref)
  • Vary, Zoom, Pan and inpainting editors
  • personalisation trained on your own ratings
  • Moodboards
  • Best-in-class in-image text rendering
  • Magic Prompt automatic prompt enhancement
  • Canvas editor with inpainting, outpainting and extend
  • Describe (image-to-prompt)
  • style references and character consistency
  • batch generation
Advantages
  • Consistently the best aesthetic output of any image generator - this is not a close contest for stylised and artistic work
  • style and character reference systems give strong series consistency
  • unlimited Relax generation on Standard and above makes high-volume exploration cheap
  • commercial rights included on all plans.
  • Text rendering is genuinely a category ahead of Midjourney and most competitors - this alone justifies it for design work involving words
  • very cheap entry price
  • Magic Prompt helps non-expert users get good results
  • Canvas editor gives real compositional control.
Limitations
  • No free tier at all, so evaluation costs money
  • no official API, which blocks programmatic integration
  • text rendering inside images remains weak compared with Ideogram
  • precise compositional control is harder than with tools offering layers or masks
  • Overall aesthetic quality trails Midjourney for purely artistic work
  • free tier generations are public, which rules it out for client work
  • Arabic and non-Latin script rendering in images remains poor
  • smaller company with less certainty than Adobe or OpenAI

Pricing notes

Midjourney

Basic $10/mo or $96/yr ($8/mo) - 3.3 Fast GPU hours (200 minutes), no Relax mode, SD video only, 3 concurrent Fast jobs. Standard $30/mo or $288/yr ($24/mo) - 15 Fast GPU hours plus unlimited Relax mode images. Pro $60/mo or $576/yr ($48/mo) - 30 Fast hours, unlimited Relax images and SD video, Stealth Mode, 12 concurrent Fast jobs. Mega $120/mo or $1,152/yr ($96/mo) - 60 Fast hours, same unlimited Relax, Stealth Mode. Additional Fast GPU time $4/hour on all plans. Annual billing saves 20%.

Ideogram

Free with a limited daily credit allowance and public generations. Basic around $8/mo ($7 annually) with priority credits and private generation. Plus around $20/mo ($16 annually) with substantially more credits. Pro around $60/mo ($48 annually) for high volume and API access. Annual billing roughly 20% cheaper.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: Midjourney ↗ · Ideogram ↗
